workflows.summary: Plan a bounded RTL architecture, implementation and focused verification change.
steps: Freeze the requested behavior, invariant and acceptance condition.
Resolve the smallest relevant RTL, interface, test and protocol context.
Implement one coherent change inside the writable scope.
Run the cheapest relevant check, then expand only when evidence supports it.
Record reset, boundary, error, backpressure and unrun-simulation risks.
completion: The focused check has an exit result and artifact or an explicit blocked/skipped reason.
No simulation is described as passed unless it actually ran.

workflows.summary: Plan a focused DV testbench, assertion, scoreboard or coverage change.
steps: Translate requirements into positive, boundary, negative, reset and recovery scenarios.
Map each scenario to stimulus, observation, checking and coverage evidence.
Preserve clear driver, monitor, scoreboard, reference-model and assertion responsibilities.
Complete static and lint validation, then present the categorized project check menu.
Let the engineer multi-select checks; run selected MCP tools or approved wrappers in order and report each result before requesting wider execution.
Separate DUT failures, sampling gaps, environment failures and coverage gaps.
completion: The selected test and source revision are recorded.
Expected behavior and failure diagnostics are explicit.
Coverage and assertion gaps remain visible instead of being inferred away.
Simulation and regression are either supported by execution evidence or marked not run, skipped or blocked.

workflows.summary: Triage a compile, elaboration, simulation, assertion, scoreboard, timeout or waveform failure.
steps: Bind the log or waveform to the current source, test, seed, simulator and command.
Classify the failure and isolate the first causal error.
Reduce to the smallest reproducible test, transaction, cycle or state transition.
State a falsifiable root-cause hypothesis and the observation that distinguishes it.
Rerun the minimal reproduction before expanding validation.
completion: The first causal failure and its evidence are identified.
The minimal reproduction has a before/after result or an explicit external blocker.
Secondary cascades are not presented as independent root causes.

workflows.summary: Plan protocol or VIP mapping, connectivity and smoke validation.
steps: Confirm the exact protocol version and layer.
Map every interface instance, clock, reset, direction, width and endpoint.
Check reset, legal transfer, backpressure, error and recovery behavior.
Separate VIP warnings, protocol violations, scoreboard mismatches and environment failures.
Record the selected pack and any project-specific mapping assumptions.
completion: The protocol pack and version assumption are explicit.
Every instance has a reviewed mapping and smoke result or a named gap.
Third-party VIP and generated files remain within their declared boundary.

workflows.summary: Perform a read-only RTL/DV correctness and evidence review.
steps: Confirm the requested scope and intended behavior.
Review the diff and surrounding reset, handshake, queue, width, error and recovery logic.
Check tests, assertions, coverage, artifacts and protected paths.
Report only actionable findings with priority, evidence, impact and correction direction.
Keep unrun checks and residual risks explicit.
completion: Every finding is tied to a path and concrete evidence.
No sign-off is claimed when required checks are skipped.
The review is read-only unless the user explicitly changes the task.

workflows.summary: Prepare a reproducible RTL/DV handoff, evidence package or sign-off record.
steps: Freeze project, source revision, target, test, seed, simulator and working directory.
Enumerate changed files and the reason for each change.
Attach exact commands, statuses, exit results and artifact paths.
Separate passed, failed, skipped, blocked and unknown checks.
Run strict evidence validation and list residual risks and coverage gaps.
completion: The evidence file matches the current project and task.
Every claimed check has execution evidence or an explicit exception.
